title: A place for ideas
body:
Your thoughts deserve a little room to grow. This is your space to capture what matters, make connections, and find your way back to a good idea.

## A little less noise. A little more clarity.
Start with a thought. It doesn’t need to be finished, organized, or particularly brilliant. Just give it a place to land.

> [!tip] Everything starts with a note
> Press **⌘ N** to make something new, or click **Edit note** to make this space your own.

## A few things in motion
- [x] Make a space for your thoughts
- [ ] Write something in [[Today’s intentions]]
- [ ] Collect a spark in [[Small observations]]
- [ ] Connect two ideas with a link

## Follow the connections
The best ideas rarely happen in isolation. Link a note with `[[double brackets]]` and let one thought lead to another.

Try exploring [[The creative process]], or start building your own [[Reading list]].

---
*A notebook is a place where you get to think out loud.*

title: Today’s intentions
body:
## What matters today
- [ ] Give one thing my full attention
- [ ] Make time for a walk
- [ ] Capture one unexpected idea

A small reminder from [[A place for ideas]]: unfinished thoughts are welcome here.

title: The creative process
body:
## Collect, connect, create
Good ideas are usually a conversation between things you already noticed.

1. Collect details in [[Small observations]].
2. Look for connections in your notes.
3. Make a small version before a big plan.

## Leave a little space
A walk, a quiet morning, a page without an agenda. Start at [[A place for ideas]].

title: A digital garden
body:
## Notes that keep growing
Think of your notes as a garden. Some are seedlings; others need pruning.

[[The creative process]] and [[Small observations]] are good starting points.

## Next steps
- [ ] Connect related thoughts
- [ ] Revisit an old idea

title: Small observations
body:
## Pay attention
- The best conversations have room for silence.
- A familiar street looks different early in the morning.
- A question can be more useful than an answer.

These little details feed [[The creative process]].

title: The art of slowing down
body:
## Create a little margin
Leave ten minutes between things. There is no need to fill every space.

A useful companion to [[Today’s intentions]].

title: Reading list
body:
## On the nightstand
- [ ] A book that challenges an assumption
- [ ] A collection of essays
- [x] A favorite worth reading twice

## Notes to keep
Save the ideas that stay with you in [[Small observations]].

title: Markdown guide
body:
## The basics
Use **bold** for emphasis, *italics* for a softer touch, and `code` for something literal.

## Organize your thoughts
Start a heading with `##`. Write a list with `-`. Add a task with `- [ ]`.

## Connect your notes
Use `[[A place for ideas]]` to link another note. Tags live beside the note title.

> [!tip] Keep your words portable
> Export any note as Markdown, or back up your whole vault from Settings.
